## Fresh factual checks

All event/session facts below were checked against primary organiser or venue pages on 24 September 2026 between 08:50 and 08:55 Europe/London unless otherwise noted.

### M Shed harbour steam train

- Source: https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/whats-on/m-shed/train-rides/
- Confirmed Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 September 2026, rides from 11am, subject to availability.
- The route runs between M Shed and SS Great Britain and is scheduled to use locomotive Henbury.
- M Shed says the working exhibit is volunteer-run and may change because of crew, mechanical or weather issues; it advises calling 0117 352 6600 before travelling.
- Fare copy (£5 return; under-sixes free) was verified against the same live venue listing on 23 September 2026 and remained inside the direct-publisher 36-hour freshness window when this campaign was scheduled. The 24 September page extract did not restate fares, so the caption also directs families to check before travelling.

### Ma-ad Science Mayhem, Bristol Dockyards

- Event: https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/ma-ad-science-mayhem
- Tickets: https://www.bristoldockyards.org/tickets
- Confirmed 26 September to 1 November 2026, with indoor and outdoor challenges included in General Admission or Afternoon Saver admission.
- Current online prices: General Admission £14.50 child / £22 adult; Afternoon Saver from 14:30 is £13 online. General Admission is valid for named return visits for twelve months; under-14s need an adult.
- This is the higher-cost option in the roundup. The public copy does not call it free or low-cost.

### Windmill Hill City Farm

- Source: https://windmillhillcityfarm.org.uk/pages/visit
- Confirmed open seven days, 09:00–17:00, with free entry and donations welcomed.
- The 4.5-acre site lists farm animals, gardens, picnic areas and a children's play area with sandpit, climbing wall, climbing net and dragon swing.
- The farm warns that paths may be muddy in wet weather.

### Arnolfini Arnold Art Cart

- Source: https://arnolfini.org.uk/whatson/arnold-art-cart/
- Confirmed free, Tuesday to Sunday 11:00–18:00, on Arnolfini's second floor.
- The cart has creative materials, exhibition-inspired activities and tabletop easels.

## Subscriber email draft — UNSENT

**Subject:** Bristol weekend: trains, science, goats and free art

**Preheader:** Four genuinely different family plans for 26–27 September, including two free options.

Hello Bristol,

This weekend’s decision is less “what is there to do?” and more “what mood are we in?”

**For train fans:** Henbury is due to steam along the harbour from M Shed on Saturday and Sunday, with rides from 11am. Returns are £5 and under-sixes ride free. It is volunteer-run, so call 0117 352 6600 before making a special journey.

**For curious kids:** Ma-ad Science Mayhem starts at Bristol Dockyards on Saturday, with challenges indoors and outside. It is included with admission; Afternoon Saver tickets are from £13 online after 2.30pm.

**For a free outdoor morning:** Windmill Hill City Farm is open 9am–5pm with animals, gardens, picnic space and a proper play area. Entry is free, donations are welcome, and wellies are sensible after rain.

**For a free indoor reset:** Arnolfini’s Arnold Art Cart is stocked with creative materials, activities and tabletop easels on the second floor. It is available 11am–6pm on Saturday and Sunday.

Our quick chooser: rain means science or art; tiny legs means farm or train; a £0 day means farm plus Art Cart.

See the Bristol guide: https://donext.co.uk/bristol/

Do check directly with each venue before travelling, especially for the volunteer-run train.

Have a good one,

DoNext Bristol
